name: Goatman
description: An umbrella name for several American urban-legend creatures described as half-man, half-goat. The best-attested versions are the Maryland Goatman of Prince George's County (popularized 1971), the Lake Worth Monster of Fort Worth, Texas (sightings July 1969), and the Pope Lick Monster of Fisherville, Kentucky.
origin: The Goatman complex is concentrated in the United States, with three major regional clusters in Maryland (Prince George's County), Texas (Fort Worth / Lake Worth), and Kentucky (Fisherville / Pope Lick).
